autor: Jetnity Trip Personal Preparation Workflow Completion 1 — Cursor Generation 1
hinweis: Getrennte Läufe. Die custom-list-Suite enthält einen Quelltextvergleich ohne Browser. Das ist kein hosted Account, kein Next-Router, kein Supabase, kein RLS und keine Production. CSS-Matrix steht separat in ablauf.json.

laeufe.name: custom-list-mounted

faelle.name: account confirms only after acceptance and one later canonical delivery
a delivery before acceptance does not confirm, and the post-acceptance read stays single
guest wrong trip blocks later submits across mode changes and keeps the draft
mode change keeps a pending intent and a late result does not replace the newer draft
an open editor returns to Offen when the preparation context changes again
a missing point and an unclear result do not send another write
filters, empty copy, named delete and a double submit stay distinct
an unreadable guest read blocks a later submit and keeps the draft
confirmation focuses the visible row and a mode change removes that target
Enter submits one create and a trip change drops the pending intent
an unclear result cannot retry or edit until a later read, and a match stays reconciled
a later account delivery recovers absence and does not confirm an unknown match
late confirmation leaves search, another editor, a filter and a hidden section alone
late confirmation leaves a status choice and a delete confirmation alone
a completed delete does not keep the old saved receipt or an enabled editor
production wiring names the canonical prop and the workspace hook

laeufe.grenze: EigeneReisevorbereitung und Hook über flaeche.tsx. Aufgeschobene Callbacks, ungestyltes HTML, synthetische beispielreise. Kein TripWorkspace, kein Next-Router, kein gehostetes Konto.
laeufe.styling: unstyled HTML; project CSS is recorded by ablauf.ts

laeufe.name: actual-workspace

faelle.name: guest create, edit, status and delete keep the sibling and use the real reader
real mode navigation keeps a pending intent, and a rejected response does not write again
a failed read of the expected trip blocks a new generation after discard and mode changes
a trip switch keeps the write that already ran and ignores its late result
account confirmation waits for a later raw canonical trip
collapsing the personal section stays collapsed when a late result arrives

laeufe.grenze: Echter TripWorkspace, echte Gast-Schreibfunktion und aktiveV3GastreiseLesen, synthetischer Speicher. Der Gastschreiber läuft beim Aufruf; nur die Antwort wird aufgeschoben. Konto-Schreibvorgänge bleiben am Adapter aufgeschoben. Kein Next-Router, kein Supabase, kein RLS, keine Production.
